luxury_sf_permits_by_cbsa_month.csv.description: CBSA-month panel of single-family building permits with luxury market flags

columns.is_top_quintile: 1 if CBSA is in top quintile (≥80th percentile) for this month, 0 otherwise
columns.is_top_decile: 1 if CBSA is in top decile (≥90th percentile) for this month, 0 otherwise
columns.p80_threshold: 80th percentile threshold for average valuation this month ($)
columns.p90_threshold: 90th percentile threshold for average valuation this month ($)

national_luxury_sf_pipeline.csv.description: National monthly aggregates of single-family building permits and luxury shares

columns.sf_val: Total valuation of single-family permits nationally ($)
columns.top_quintile_units: Number of SF units in CBSAs flagged as top quintile
columns.top_quintile_share: Share of SF units in top quintile CBSAs
columns.top_decile_units: Number of SF units in CBSAs flagged as top decile
columns.top_decile_share: Share of SF units in top decile CBSAs
